in_hebrew.name: Trista
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Trista הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word ‘tristus’, meaning ‘third’ or ‘sorrowful’. In Christian tradition, Trista may symbolize the third person of the Holy Trinity or the third day of creation. It is also a popular given name in the Middle Ages.
